faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: No. Shrunk suggests the clips, reframes them to 9:16 and generates captions from the transcript. The editor lets you adjust trimming, captions and framing, but it is never required.
faq.a2: YouTube and Instagram publish directly; TikTok sends the video to your TikTok inbox so you finish in the app. Instagram requires a professional account (Business or Creator). To import, drop a video file or paste a direct link to a file.
faq.a3: Yes, in one click from Billing. The subscription stops at the end of the current period, with no further charge. You can also request a refund within {days} days of subscribing if fewer than {max} renders were delivered.
faq.a4: Unless you cancel before the 7 days end, the subscription to the plan you chose continues at the displayed price, VAT included, until you cancel. You can cancel at any time from Billing.
faq.a5: Your videos and clips are stored in your account's workspace and are only reachable through time-limited signed links. Nothing is published without your action. To suggest clips, your video's transcript is analysed by an AI model (Anthropic).
faq.q6: Can I use another creator's video?
faq.a6: Only if you have the right to: the author's permission or a licence that allows it. A public video is not automatically free to reuse. You confirm your rights before every import.
faq.a7: YouTube does not allow third-party services to download its videos. When you paste a YouTube link, we show the video card, then you upload the matching file.
